description: The trading-session structure for one exchange, in exchange-local decimal hours (9.5 = 09:30). A four-number "main" means a lunch break (e.g. Tokyo 9–11.5, 12.5–15).

exchange.description: Exchange id (e.g. "nyse", "nasdaq", "lse", "nikkei", "hkex") OR common name/city (e.g. "New York Stock Exchange", "Tokyo", "London"). Case-insensitive.

name: get_trading_sessions
